0022600004.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Miami Heat host the Minnesota Timberwolves. For Miami, Bam Adebayo (groin), Dru Smith (calf strain) and Pelle Larsson (illness) are all day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery, out) and has Enrique Freeman (shoulder) and Rocco Zikarsky (undisclosed) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Heat lost both meetings with the Timberwolves in 2025-26, most recently 122-94 in Minneapolis on January 6, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Miami a 50% chance of winning.
